Synthetic eligible medical expenses

This synthetic page explains, for testing only, which medical expenses a fictional tax credit accepts. You can claim eligible expenses paid in any 12-month period ending in the tax year, as long as nobody was reimbursed for them.

Who can claim

You can claim expenses you paid for yourself, your spouse or common-law partner, and your children under 18. Reimbursed amounts from an extended health plan cannot be claimed, but the part you paid yourself can.

Common eligible expenses

ExpenseEligibleConditions
Registered massage therapySometimesOnly when the practitioner is authorised in your province
Prescription glassesYesPrescribed by an optometrist or medical doctor
Dental cleaningsYesCosmetic procedures are not eligible
Health plan premiumsYesOnly the part you paid, not your employer
Gym membershipsNoGeneral fitness is not a medical expense

Keeping receipts

Keep your receipts in case you are asked for them. Receipts should show the provider, the patient, the service date and the amount paid.
